title: Accounts Receivable Note: Account Standing Courtesy on a Respite Level-Change Segment
content:
The standing of a stay account under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement earns a courtesy on the care increase of a level-change segment on an Assisted Living Respite Stay.

**Rule.** The account standing courtesy on the re-leveled nights is two percent (2 percent) where the stay account shows no returned payment and at least two payments, one percent (1 percent) where it shows no returned payment and exactly one payment, and nothing otherwise.

**How it is taken.** The courtesy reduces the care increase billed per re-leveled night by its percentage of that care increase as it stands: the amount is multiplied by 98 percent at 2 percent and by 99 percent at 1 percent.

**What is counted.** The payment entries and the returned-payment entries on the ledger of the stay itself; payments and returns on the guest's other Larkspur accounts are not part of the stay account.

## Truth table

| Returned payments on the stay account | Payments on the stay account | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| None | Two or more | 2 percent |
| None | Exactly one | 1 percent |
| None | None | Nothing |
| One or more | Any number | Nothing |

## Hypothetical accounts

- Three payments posted, none returned: 2 percent.
- One payment posted, none returned: 1 percent.
- Two payments posted, one of them returned: nothing, since the account shows a returned payment.
